title: Get usage this billing period
description: Usage so far this billing period. Per usage key it returns the usage, the limit in effect and today's usage where PostHog tracks it. It also says whether PostHog is limiting the resource right now. Per product and add-on it returns the current usage, limit, ratio and over-limit flag. It returns quantities only, with the last date the usage reports cover. It is an organization total, so it needs full billing access. billing-usage-timeseries-get reads the same numbers per project with usage read access, and billing-usage-status-get is the read for members. Use it for "how many events have we used". For amounts call billing-spend-summary-get, and for usage over time call billing-usage-timeseries-get. Beta: behind the organization-billing-api flag, and the output shape may change while it is.

methodDocumentation.text: In beta: the organization billing API is behind the organization-billing-api feature flag and answers 403 without it, so ask support for access. Its shapes may change while it is in beta.
